text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down slightly over 24 hours, with BTC's 0.9% decline outpacing ETH's 0.4% drop, suggesting modest risk-off pressure on the larger asset. The Fear & Greed Index holding steady at 69 (Greed) and BTC dominance at 58.4% indicate traders remain confident but not euphoric, with capital still flowing into altcoins like BNB despite the broader pullback. The $91B in daily volume is healthy enough to absorb the moves without signs of distress.
